title: Z8 daily-use QA battery
note: What an ordinary user does with the camera every day, one item per operation, judged against the behaviour a working build shows. Judgement is dynamic: the rule reads what the run recorded. A surface the run did not reach reports NOT_EXERCISED and never PASS, and the item says what would reach it. Session arguments are the operator's; this file ships no coordinate and no key-body mapping.

items.title: power on reaches live view
items.sequence: insert card, press power, wait for live view
items.expected: live view frames start, no crash

items.title: power off shuts down cleanly
items.sequence: hold power, confirm off
items.expected: shutdown completes, no crash, no stale state on next boot
items.alternative: bench: power-off is a machine reset plus a clean teardown watch; a real button press is not available

items.title: sleep and wake resume the session
items.sequence: leave idle until sleep, press half shutter to wake
items.expected: sleep entered, wake restores live view
items.alternative: bench: idle-to-sleep needs the real power manager; only the wake path can be driven

items.title: P mode takes a picture
items.sequence: dial to P, half press, full press

items.title: A mode takes a picture
items.sequence: dial to A, half press, full press

items.title: S mode takes a picture
items.sequence: dial to S, half press, full press

items.title: M mode takes a picture
items.sequence: dial to M, half press, full press

items.title: single, continuous and self-timer release
items.sequence: release single, hold for burst, set timer and release
items.expected: one frame, a burst of frames, a delayed frame

items.title: half press focuses, full press releases
items.sequence: half press and hold, then full press
items.expected: focus step on half press, frame on full press

items.title: exposure compensation, ISO and white balance change
items.sequence: turn EV dial, change ISO, change WB
items.expected: settings change and are applied to the next frame
items.alternative: bench: settings are key-body driven; the field mapping stays with the operator

items.title: live view streams frames
items.sequence: leave the camera in live view

items.title: flip screen switches the output
items.sequence: open and close the tilt screen
items.expected: output switches between panel and viewfinder
items.alternative: bench: the panel switch is a GPIO fixture on the model, not a mechanical sensor

items.title: playback shows the last frame
items.sequence: press playback

items.title: zoom in and out in playback
items.sequence: press zoom in, press zoom out

items.title: protect and delete a frame
items.sequence: protect a frame, then delete another

items.title: slideshow and histogram
items.sequence: start slideshow, show histogram

items.title: record starts and stops
items.sequence: press record, wait, press stop
items.expected: a clip is written and closed

items.title: menu browsing answers every step
items.sequence: open menu, page through, back out

items.title: common settings change and stick
items.sequence: change quality, focus mode, metering, colour, sound, brightness, date and time
items.expected: each change is stored and shown

items.title: card swap takes effect
items.sequence: power off, swap the card, power on
items.expected: the new card is mounted and its content listed

items.title: dual card switch is explicit
items.sequence: set the second card as the main one
items.expected: the camera states which card it writes to
items.alternative: bench: one card slot in the model; the dual-card branch is covered by host-side vectors

items.title: card full is reported
items.sequence: fill the card, take a picture
items.expected: a card-full message, no data loss

items.title: format card works
items.sequence: menu: format card, confirm

items.title: battery level is shown and low battery is reported
items.sequence: read the level, drain to low
items.alternative: bench: battery level is a service-core fixture value; a real gauge is not available

items.title: USB connection is detected and released
items.sequence: connect USB, disconnect
items.alternative: bench: USB is a device model; host enumeration is outside the model

items.title: shutter without a card is refused with a message
items.sequence: remove the card, press the shutter
items.expected: no frame is written, an error is shown

items.title: power on without a battery does nothing harmful
items.sequence: attempt to power on with no battery
items.alternative: bench: the power fixture always supplies a battery; the no-battery path is not modelled
